talfiq.body: Isku darka madhabyada si loo fududeeyo lama jecla. Raac hagidda macallinkaaga.

picker.title: Madhabkayga
picker.subtitle: Xukunnada app-ka oo dhan waxay raacaan madhabka aad doorato. Kala duwanaanshaha had iyo jeer waa la calaamadeeyaa, aragtiyaha kalena waxay u jiraan hal taabasho.

desc.hanafi: Madhabka Imaam Abuu Xaniifa (wuxuu dhintay 150 H). Si ballaaran ayaa loogu raacaa Koonfurta iyo Bartamaha Aasiya, Turkiga iyo Balkanka.
desc.shafii: Madhabka Imaam ash-Shaafici (wuxuu dhintay 204 H). Si ballaaran ayaa loogu raacaa Koonfur-bari Aasiya, Bariga Afrika, Yaman iyo qaybo ka mid ah Bariga Dhexe.
desc.maliki: Madhabka Imaam Maalik ibn Anas (wuxuu dhintay 179 H). Si ballaaran ayaa loogu raacaa Waqooyiga iyo Galbeedka Afrika.
desc.hanbali: Madhabka Imaam Axmed ibn Xanbal (wuxuu dhintay 241 H). Si ballaaran ayaa loogu raacaa Jasiiradda Carabta.

picker.allViewsDesc: Ha dooran madhab — arag mowqifka madhab kasta dhinac-dhinac.

notSure.title: Ma hubtid?
notSure.a11y: Ma hubtid midka aad dooranayso? Muuji hagid
notSure.body: Raac waxa ay raacaan qoyskaagu, masjidka xaafaddaadu ama macallinkaagu. Afarta madhab dhammaantood waa waddooyin sax ah oo la aqoonsan yahay oo ka mid ah cilmiga Ahlu Sunnah. Haddii aadan hubin, dooro "Muuji dhammaan aragtiyaha" — waad beddeli kartaa wakhti kasta gudaha Dejinta.

start.title: Goorta uu Casarku bilaabmo
start.hanafi: Marka hooska shay uu noqdo laba jeer dhererkiisa (oo lagu daray hooskiisa duhurka).
start.majority: Marka hooska shay uu la egyahay dhererkiisa (oo lagu daray hooskiisa duhurka).

preferred.title: Wakhtiga la door bido ee Casarka
preferred.hanafi: Dib u dhigiddiisa ayaa la door bidaa, inta qorraxdu aysan huruud noqon.
preferred.majority: In lagu tukado bilowga wakhtigiisa ayaa la door bidaa.

preferred.title: Wakhtiga la door bido ee Fajarka
preferred.hanafi: Isfaar: marka iftiinka waaberigu faafo, iyadoo wakhti loo deynayo in salaadda lagu celiyo haddii loo baahdo.
preferred.majority: Taghliis: goor hore, iyadoo weli mugdi tahay.

start.title: Goorta ay Cishaadu bilaabanto (macluumaad ahaan)
start.hanafi: Kadib marka shafaqa cad libdho (Abuu Xaniifa). Fataawo badan oo Xanafi ah waxay raacaan labadiisa arday: kadib shafaqa cas.

preferred.title: Wakhtiga la door bido ee Cishaha
preferred.delay: Dib u dhigiddeeda ilaa saddex-meelood meel habeenka ayaa la door bidaa.
preferred.shafii: In goor hore la tukado ayaa la door bidaa (aragti kale oo madhabka ka mid ah waxay door bidaa dib u dhigiddeeda).
preferred.maliki: In goor hore la tukado ayaa la door bidaa, gaar ahaan jamaacooyinka.
preferred.hanbali: Dib u dhigiddeeda ilaa saddex-meelood meel habeenka ayaa la door bidaa, haddii aysan ku adkayn dadka kale.

status.title: Xukunka Witirka
status.hanafi: Waajib: ka hooseeya faral, ka sarreeya sunne.
status.majority: Sunne mu'akkada (sunne si adag loo xoojiyay).

form.title: Sida Witirka loo tukado
form.hanafi: Saddex rakcadood hal salaan ah; qunuut ka hor rukuuca rakcadda saddexaad, sannadka oo dhan.
form.shafii: Ugu yaraan hal rakac, inta badan saddex (laba, kadibna hal), ugu badnaan kow iyo toban; qunuut kadib rukuuca badhka labaad ee Ramadaan.
form.maliki: Hal rakac oo la tukado kadib shafc laba rakcadood ah oo gooni ah; Witirka qunuut kuma jiro.
form.hanbali: Ugu yaraan hal rakac, inta badan saddex, ugu badnaan kow iyo toban; qunuut kadib rukuuca, sannadka oo dhan.

qaza.title: Qadada Witirka la seegay
qaza.hanafi: Waa waajib: Witirka la seegay waa la qadeeyaa.
qaza.recommended: Waa la jecel yahay: waa wanaagsan tahay in la qadeeyo.
qaza.maliki: Lama qadeeyo marka salaadda Fajarka la tukado kadib.

raisingHands.title: Gacmaha kor u qaadista salaadda
raisingHands.shafii: Takbiirka furitaanka, ka hor rukuuca, marka laga soo kaco rukuuca, iyo marka loo istaago rakcadda saddexaad.
raisingHands.maliki: Kaliya takbiirka furitaanka (aragtida caanka ah ee madhabka).
raisingHands.hanbali: Takbiirka furitaanka, ka hor rukuuca, iyo marka laga soo kaco rukuuca.

fatihaBehindImam.title: Akhriska Al-Faatixa gadaasha imaamka
fatihaBehindImam.hanafi: Lama akhriyo: ma'muumku wuu dhegaystaa, akhriska imaamkuna waa ku filan yahay.
fatihaBehindImam.shafii: Waa waajib ku ah ma'muumka rakac kasta oo salaad kasta ah.
fatihaBehindImam.maliki: Waxaa lagu akhriyaa salaadaha sirta ah; kuwa jahriga ah ma'muumku wuu dhegaystaa.
fatihaBehindImam.hanbali: Waa la jecel yahay salaadaha sirta ah iyo hakadyada imaamka; haddii kale ma'muumku wuu dhegaystaa.

fajrQunut.title: Qunuutka Fajarka
fajrQunut.shafii: Waa sunne: waxaa la yiraahdaa iyadoo la taagan yahay kadib rukuuca rakcadda labaad.
fajrQunut.maliki: Waa la jecel yahay: si hoose ayaa loo yiraahdaa ka hor rukuuca rakcadda labaad.
fajrQunut.hanbali: Lama sameeyo, marka laga reebo qunuutka xilliyada musiibada (naasila).

lastSitting.title: Habka fadhiga tashahudka dambe
lastSitting.hanafi: Iftiraash (ku fadhiisashada cagta bidix, cagta midigna taagan) fadhi kasta, oo uu ku jiro kan dambe.
lastSitting.shafii: Tawarruk (dhulka ku fadhiisasho, cagta bidix ka hoosaysa lugta midig) fadhiga dambe ee salaad kasta, xataa salaadda laba rakcadood; iftiraash kuwa kale.
lastSitting.maliki: Tawarruk fadhi kasta, kan hore iyo kan dambe.
lastSitting.hanbali: Tawarruk kaliya fadhiga dambe ee salaad leh laba tashahud (saddex ama afar rakcadood); haddii kale iftiraash.

firstTashahhud.title: Xukunka tashahudka hore
firstTashahhud.wajib: Waajib: haddii la illoobo, sujuudda halmaanku salaadda ayay hagaajisaa.
firstTashahhud.sunnah: Sunne: haddii la illoobo, waxaa lagu magdhabaa sujuudda halmaanka.

abandoning.title: Xukunka qofka ka taga salaadda
abandoning.majority: Dembi weyn oo culus; qofku wuxuu ahaanayaa Muslim inta uusan dafirin waajibnimada salaadda.
abandoning.hanbali: Aragtida la isku halleeyo: qofka ku adkaysta ka tagiddeeda kadib marka maamulku u yeedho waxaa lagu xukumaa inuu Islaamka ka baxay.

minCongregation.title: Tirada ugu yar ee jamaacada Jimcaha
minCongregation.hanafi: Saddex nin oo aan imaamka ahayn.
minCongregation.forty: Afartan nin, imaamka oo ku jira.
minCongregation.maliki: Laba iyo toban nin oo aan imaamka ahayn.

sunnah.title: Sunnaha ka hor iyo ka dib Jimcaha
sunnah.hanafi: Afar rakcadood ka hor iyo afar ka dib, labaduba sunne mu'akkada (Abu Yuusuf: lix ka dib — dad badan waxay tukadaan afar, kadib laba).
sunnah.shafii: Sida Duhurka: laba rakcadood ka hor iyo laba ka dib waa la adkeeyay; afar iyo afar ayaa dhammaystira.
sunnah.maliki: Ma jiro sunne go'an (raatibo) ka hor ama ka dib; salaad nafil ah waa la oggol yahay.
sunnah.hanbali: Ma jiro sunne go'an ka hor (nafil ka hor waa la jecel yahay); ka dib, ugu yaraan laba rakcadood ilaa lix.

status.title: Xukunka salaadda Ciidda
status.hanafi: Waa waajib ku ah kuwa ay waajib ku tahay inay Jimcaha yimaadaan.

extraTakbirs.title: Takbiirrada dheeraadka ah ee salaadda Ciidda
extraTakbirs.hanafi: Saddex rakac kasta: ka hor akhriska kan koowaad, kadib akhriska kan labaad.
extraTakbirs.shafii: Toddoba rakcadda koowaad iyo shan tan labaad, marka laga reebo takbiirka furitaanka iyo takbiirka istaagga.
extraTakbirs.sixFive: Lix rakcadda koowaad (toddoba haddii takbiirka furitaanka lagu daro) iyo shan tan labaad.

fatiha.title: Al-Faatixa salaadda janaasada
fatiha.hanafi: Looma akhriyo akhris ahaan; ammaanta Alle ayaa raacda takbiirka koowaad.
fatiha.maliki: Lama akhriyo; takbiirrada waxaa raaca ammaan iyo duco.

preset.title: Sunnooyinka rawaatibka ah ee caadiga u ah app-ka
preset.hanafi: 12 rakcadood: 2 ka hor Fajarka, 4 ka hor iyo 2 kadib Duhurka, 2 kadib Maqribka, 2 kadib Cishaha.
preset.ten: 10 rakcadood: 2 ka hor Fajarka, 2 ka hor iyo 2 kadib Duhurka, 2 kadib Maqribka, 2 kadib Cishaha.
preset.maliki: App-ku wuxuu isticmaalaa habka 10-ka rakcadood. Qoraallada Maalikiga waxay ku dhiirrigeliyaan salaad nafilo ah xilliyadan agagaarkooda iyagoon tiro go'aamin.

fajrMakeup.title: Qadada sunnada Subax
fajrMakeup.hanafi: Waxaa lala qadeeyaa Subaxa dhaafay, ka hor zawaalka. Haddii sunnada oo keliya dhaafto lama qadeeyo (Abu Xaniifa, Abu Yuusuf); Maxamed wuxuu oggolaaday qorrax ka dib ilaa zawaal.
fajrMakeup.recommended: Waa la jecel yahay in la qadeeyo haddii la dhaafo, xataa qorrax ka dib.
fajrMakeup.maliki: Nawaafisha keliya ee la qadeeyo — qorrax ka dib ilaa zawaal.

rakahs.title: Tirada rakcadaha Taraawiixda (macluumaad ahaan)
rakahs.maliki: Labaatan; soddon iyo lix waxay ahayd dhaqankii hore ee dadka Madiina.

takbir.title: Takbiirka Tashriiqa kadib salaadaha faralka ah
takbir.hanafi: Waa waajib, laga bilaabo Fajarka 9-ka ilaa Casarka 13-ka Dul-Xijja; wuxuu ku bilaabmaa laba takbiir.
takbir.shafii: Waa sunne, laga bilaabo Fajarka 9-ka ilaa Casarka 13-ka Dul-Xijja; wuxuu ku bilaabmaa saddex takbiir.
takbir.maliki: Waa sunne, laga bilaabo Duhurka 10-ka ilaa Fajarka 13-ka Dul-Xijja; saddex takbiir.
takbir.hanbali: Waa sunne, laga bilaabo Fajarka 9-ka ilaa Casarka 13-ka Dul-Xijja; wuxuu ku bilaabmaa laba takbiir.

min.title: Muddada ugu gaaban ee xayda
min.maliki: Cibaadada dhinaceeda ma jiro wax ugu yar: dhiig kasta wuu xisaabmaa.

max.title: Muddada ugu dheer ee xayda
max.maliki: Shan iyo toban maalmood. Haweeneyda caado joogto ah leh waxay ku dartaa ilaa saddex maalmood (istidhhaar), weligeedna kama gudubto shan iyo toban.

minPurity.title: Muddada ugu gaaban ee daahirnimada u dhaxaysa laba xayd

beyondMax.title: Dhiigga ka badan muddada ugu dheer
beyondMax.hanafi: Istixaado: salaadda dib u bilow, adigoo weyso cusub u qaadanaya wakhti salaad kasta.
beyondMax.habitColour: Istixaado: maalmaha waxaa lagu kala saaraa caadadeeda ama midabka dhiigga.
beyondMax.maliki: Istixaado: salaadda dib u bilow (weyso cusub salaad kasta waa la jecel yahay).

quranRecitation.title: Akhrinta Qur'aanka xilliga caadada
quranRecitation.majority: Looma akhriyo sida Qur'aan. Dhegaysigu waa bannaan yahay, erayada Qur'aankana waxaa loo oran karaa dikri ama ducaa ahaan.
quranRecitation.maliki: Waxay ka akhrin kartaa xifdigeeda; ma taabato Mushafka.

max.title: Muddada ugu dheer ee nifaaska (dhiigga dhalmada kadib)

distance.title: Masaafada gaabinta salaadda (qasriga)
distance.hanafi: Qiyaastii 77–78 km (48 mayl): socod saddex maalmood ah sida cabbirka qadiimka ah.
distance.majority: Qiyaastii 81–89 km (afar burud); beddelka cabbirka hore wuu kala duwan yahay.

status.title: Xukunka qasriga safarka
status.hanafi: Waa waajib: musaafurku wuxuu tukadaa laba rakcadood, ma aha afar.
status.concession: Waa rukhso; qasrigu waa ka fiican yahay.

residency.title: Goorta musaafurku noqdo deggane
residency.hanafi: Marka uu niyaysto inuu joogo 15 maalmood ama ka badan.
residency.shafii: Marka uu niyaysto inuu joogo 4 maalmood oo buuxa ama ka badan, iyadoo aan la xisaabin maalmaha imaatinka iyo ka bixitaanka.
residency.maliki: Marka uu niyaysto inuu joogo 4 maalmood oo buuxa (qiyaastii 20 salaadood) ama ka badan.
residency.hanbali: Marka uu niyaysto inuu joogo in ka badan 4 maalmood (in ka badan 20 salaadood).

travel.title: Isku darka salaadaha (jamac) safarka
travel.hanafi: Lama oggola, marka laga reebo Carafa iyo Muzdalifa xilliga Xajka.
travel.allowed: Waa la oggol yahay: hor u keenid (taqdiim) ama dib u dhigid (ta'khiir).
travel.maliki: Waa la oggol yahay shuruud, inta badan marka la socdo.

rain.title: Isku darka salaadaha roobka awgii
rain.shafii: Waa la oggol yahay Duhurka iyo Casarka, iyo Maqribka iyo Cishaha, hor u keenid ahaan, jamaaco ahaan.
rain.maghribIsha: Waa la oggol yahay Maqribka iyo Cishaha.

rawatib.title: Sunnooyinka rawaatibka safarka
rawatib.hanafi: Waa ikhtiyaari marka la socdo, marka laga reebo sunnaha Fajarka; waa la jecel yahay marka la dego.
rawatib.optional: Weli waa sunne; musaafurku wuu dhaafi karaa.
rawatib.hanbali: Musaafurku wuu dhaafi karaa, marka laga reebo sunnaha Fajarka iyo Witirka.

nisabBasis.title: Nisaabka lacagta caddaanka ah iyo badeecadaha ganacsiga
nisabBasis.hanafi: Midkii qiimihiisu ka yar yahay dahabka iyo fiddada, maadaama ay u roon tahay faqiirka.
nisabBasis.contested: Dahab ama fidda. Lacagta casriga ah, culimada casrigu way ku kala duwan yihiin; app-ku wuxuu ku bilaabmaa dahab wuxuuna kuu oggolaanayaa inaad beddesho.
nisabBasis.hanbali: Qiimaha ugu faa'iidada badan faqiirka: dhab ahaan, midka ka yar dahabka iyo fiddada.

combineGoldSilver.title: Isku darka dahabka iyo fiddada si loo gaaro nisaabka
combineGoldSilver.shafii: Maya: macdan kasta gooni ayaa loo xisaabiyaa.
combineGoldSilver.parts: Haa, iyadoo loo eegayo qaybta mid kastaa ka yahay nisaabkiisa.

jewellery.title: Sakada dahabka iyo qurxinta shakhsiga ah ee haweenka
jewellery.hanafi: Sako waa waajib qurxinta dahabka iyo fiddada ah.
jewellery.majority: Sako kuma laha qurxinta la oggol yahay ee si caadi ah loo isticmaalo.

forgetfulEating.title: Cunid ama cabbid illoobid ah inta la soonman yahay
forgetfulEating.majority: Soonku wuu ansax ahaanayaa; sii wad soonka.
forgetfulEating.maliki: Soonku wuu jabaa waana la qadeeyaa (soonka waajibka ah); kafaaro ma leh.

kaffarah.title: Waxa kafaaro keena Ramadaanka
kaffarah.eatingToo: Galmo ula kac ah, ama cunid ama cabbid ula kac ah.

afterMidShaban.title: Soonka sunnaha ah kadib badhtamaha Shacbaan
afterMidShaban.shafii: Lama oggola (aragtida la isku halleeyo), haddii aysan ahayn caado, ku xiran soonka ka horreeya 15-ka, qado ama nadar.
afterMidShaban.noRule: Xayiraad gaar ah ma jirto; in la soomo maalin ama laba toos ugu horraysa Ramadaan lama jecla haddii aysan caado ahayn.

measure.title: Fidyada soon kasta oo la seegay
measure.hanafi: Nus saac oo sarreen ah, ama hal saac oo timir ama shaciir ah; in qiimahiisa lacag ahaan la bixiyo waa la oggol yahay.
measure.shafii: Hal mudd oo ah cuntada aasaasiga ah ee deegaanka, cunto ahaan la bixiyo.
measure.maliki: Hal mudd oo ah cuntada aasaasiga ah ee deegaanka, cunto ahaan la bixiyo (dadka aadka u da'da weyn waa la jecel yahay halkii waajib ka ahaan lahayd).
measure.hanbali: Hal mudd oo sarreen ah ama nus saac oo cunto kale ah, cunto ahaan la bixiyo.

measure.title: Sakaatul-fidriga qofkiiba
measure.hanafi: Nus saac oo sarreen ah ama hal saac oo cuntooyin kale ah; in qiimahiisa lacag ahaan la bixiyo waa la oggol yahay.
measure.majority: Hal saac oo ah cuntada aasaasiga ah ee deegaanka, cunto ahaan la bixiyo.

wudu.title: Weysada dawaafka
wudu.hanafi: Waa waajib: dawaafka weyso la'aanta ah wuu xisaabmaa laakiin wuxuu keenaa ganaax.
wudu.majority: Waa shardi: dawaafka weyso la'aanta ah ma xisaabmo.

status.title: Xukunka udxiyada (allabariga Ciidda)
status.hanafi: Waa waajib ku ah deggane haysta nisaab; waa la gowrac karaa ilaa qorrax dhaca 12-ka.
status.shafii: Sunne mu'akkada; waa la gowrac karaa ilaa qorrax dhaca 13-ka.
status.sunnah12: Sunne mu'akkada; waa la gowrac karaa ilaa qorrax dhaca 12-ka.

hairNails.title: Jarista timaha iyo ciddiyaha tobanka maalmood ee hore (marka la allabaryayo)
hairNails.hanafi: Waa la jecel yahay in laga fogaado.
hairNails.hanbali: Lama oggola (waa xaaraan) ilaa xoolaha la gowraco.

grandfatherSiblings.title: Awowga iyo walaalaha (dhaxalka)
grandfatherSiblings.hanafi: Awowgu wuxuu ka reebaa (xajbaa) walaalaha buuxa iyo walaalaha aabbe, sida aabbaha oo kale (aragtida Abuu Xaniifa).
grandfatherSiblings.majority: Way la qaybsadaan (muqaasamo); wuxuu qaataa midka u roon: qaybsiga, saddex-meelood meel inta hartay, ama lix-meelood meel.

mushtarakah.title: Kiiska wadaagga (al-Mushtaraka)
mushtarakah.excluded: Walaalaha buuxa waxba ma helaan marka saamiyada go'an ay dhammeeyaan dhaxalka.
mushtarakah.share: Walaalaha buuxa waxay si siman ula qaybsadaan walaalaha hooyo saddex-meelood meeshooda.

paternalGrandmother.title: Ayeeyada aabbe marka aabbuhu nool yahay
paternalGrandmother.hanbali: Weli way dhaxashaa: wiilkeedu kama reebo.

radd.title: Celinta dheeraadka dhaxlayaasha (radd)
radd.heirs: Dheeraadku wuxuu ku noqdaa dhaxlayaasha saamiyada go'an leh, marka laga reebo isqabayaasha.
radd.treasury: Asal ahaan wuxuu aadaa khasnadda dawladda (baytul-maal); culimadii dambe waxay u celiyaan dhaxlayaasha meesha aysan jirin khasnad habaysan.

malikiyyah.title: Awoowe, walaalaha hooyada iyo walaal wiil oo aabbe ah (al-Malikiyyah)
malikiyyah.hanafi: Awoowuhu walaalaha oo dhan wuu xijbiyaa si kastaba, sidaa darteed wuxuu qaataa saddex meelood meelka hartay.
malikiyyah.zayd: Habka guud ee Zayd ayaa la dabaqaa: awoowaha iyo walaalka aabbe midkiiba wuxuu qaataa lix meelood meel.
malikiyyah.maliki: Awoowuhu wuxuu qaataa dhammaan saddex meelood meelka hartay; walaalaha aabbe waxba ma helaan (al-Malikiyyah).

intention.title: Niyadda weysada
intention.hanafi: Sunne: weyso aan niyad lahayn waxay weli ka saartaa xadaska yar, laakiin ajirku wuxuu u baahan yahay niyad.
intention.majority: Waa lagama maarmaan: weyso aan niyad lahayn ma ansaxdo.

tartib.title: Kala horraynta (tartiib) dhaqidda
tartib.sunnah: Sunne: weysada aan raacin kala horraynta Qur'aanka weli waa ansax.
tartib.fard: Waajib: xubnaha waa in lagu dhaqaa kala horraynta Qur'aanka.

muwalat.title: Isku xigxiga (muwaalaad) weysada
muwalat.sunnah: Sunne: hakad u dhexeeya dhaqidda ma burinayo weysada.
muwalat.maliki: Waajib marka la xasuusto oo la awoodo: hakad dheer oo ula kac ah ayaa burinaya; mid illoobid ah waa la cafiyay.
muwalat.hanbali: Waajib: xubin waa inaan la daynin inay qallaydo ka hor inta aan la dhaqin tan xigta, xaaladaha caadiga ah.

dalk.title: Xoqidda xubnaha (dalk)
dalk.majority: Sunne: biyaha oo ku dul socda xubinta ayaa ku filan; xoqiddu waa la jecel yahay.
dalk.maliki: Waajib: gacanta biyaha la marin xubin kasta oo la dhaqay.

touchOppositeSex.title: Taabashada jinsiga kale
touchOppositeSex.shafii: Waxay jebisaa weysada: isu taabashada maqaarka ee rag iyo dumar qaangaar ah oo aan maxram ahayn, xataa iyadoon shahwo jirin.
touchOppositeSex.desire: Weysada waxay jebisaa oo kaliya haddii shahwo jirto, ula kac ama la dareemay.

touchPrivateParts.title: Taabashada cawrada
touchPrivateParts.shafii: Weysada waa jabtaa haddii cawrada hore ama dambe si toos ah loogu taabto calaacasha ama gudaha farta.
touchPrivateParts.maliki: Weysada ninka waa jabtaa haddii uu si toos ah cawradiisa ugu taabto calaacasha ama gudaha farta; dumarka, culimada madhabku way ku kala duwan yihiin.
touchPrivateParts.hanbali: Weysada waa jabtaa haddii cawrada si toos ah gacan loogu taabto.

debtsToAllah.title: Sako, fidyo iyo kafaaro aan la bixin markii qofku dhintay
debtsToAllah.third: Waxaa la bixiyaa oo kaliya haddii qofku dardaarmay, waxaana laga bixiyaa saddex-meelood-meel.
debtsToAllah.capital: Waxaa laga bixiyaa dhammaan dhaxalka ka hor wasiyadaha iyo qaybinta dhaxalka, sida deymaha dadka, ha la dardaarmo ama yaan la dardaarmin.

noHeirs.title: In laga badiyo saddex-meelood-meel marka aysan jirin wax dhaxal-qaate ah
noHeirs.whole: Waa la oggol yahay: haddii aysan jirin dhaxal-qaate gabi ahaanba, wasiyaddu waxay qaadan kartaa dhammaan dhaxalka.
noHeirs.third: Weli waxay ku eg tahay saddex-meelood-meel; inta kale waxay aadaysaa khasnadda guud (baytul-maal).

tahiyyat.title: Tahiyyat al-masjid waqtiyada la nacay iyo inta khudbadu socoto
tahiyyat.notDislikedTimes: Waa Sunno, laakiin lama tukado waqtiyada salaadda sunnada ah la nacay (Subax iyo Casar kadib, marka qorraxdu soo baxayso, duhur-dhexaadka iyo marka ay dhacayso), ama marka imaamku bilaabo khudbadda Jimcaha.
tahiyyat.shafii: Waa Sunno, waxaana la tukadaa xitaa waqtiyada la nacay maxaa yeelay sabab ayay leedahay (galitaanka masjidka). Inta khudbadda Jimcuhu socoto, laba rakcadood oo gaagaaban ayaa la tukadaa.
tahiyyat.hanbali: Waa Sunno. Aragtida la isku halleeyo waa in aan la tukan waqtiyada la nacay (riwaayad kale oo ka timid Imaam Axmad ayaa banneysa); inta khudbadda Jimcuhu socoto, laba rakcadood oo gaagaaban ayaa la tukadaa.

taqsir.title: Intee nin gaabiyaa timaha (taqsir)
taqsir.hanafi: Ugu yaraan rubuc madaxa waa in la xiiro ama la gaabiyo.
taqsir.shafii: Ugu yaraan saddex tin oo madaxa ah, la xiiray ama la gaabiyay, ayaa ku filan.
taqsir.wholeHead: Madaxa oo dhan: in qayb keliya la gaabiyo kuma filna.

onboarding.title: Madhabkaaga
onboarding.body: Xukunnada hagayaasha iyo xisaabiyeyaasha waxay raaci karaan madhabkaaga. Kala duwanaanshuhu had iyo jeer wuu calaamadaysan yahay, waxaadna tan ku beddeli kartaa wakhti kasta Dejinta.

detail.subtitle: Sida afarta madhab ee Sunniga ah ugu kala duwan yihiin xukunkan, iyo caddaymahooda.

kind.dhul_hijjah_nine: Sagaalka maalmood ee hore ee Dul-Xijjo

reason.tashriq: Maalmaha Tashriiqa (11–13 Dul-Xijjo) waa maalmo cunid, cabbid iyo xusidda Alle. Soomitaankooda lama oggola.
reason.ramadan: Tani waa maalin Ramadaan ah. Ku diiwaangeli shaashadda Ramadaanka.
reason.dayOfDoubt: Maalinta shakiga (30 Shacbaan): culimadu way ku kala aragti duwan yihiin. Qaar badan ayaa karaahiyeeya in la soomo, gaar ahaan iyadoo taxaddar loogu sameynayo Ramadaanka. Soon qado ah waa la soomi karaa.
reason.beforeRamadan: Ha soomin maalin ama laba ka hor Ramadaanka, haddii aanu ahayn soon aad si joogto ah u soomi jirtay, sida Isniinta iyo Khamiista.
reason.fridayAlone: Culimo badan (madhabyada Shaafici iyo Xanbali) waxay karaahiyeeyaan in Jimcaha keligiis loo gooyo soon sunno ah; qaar kale way oggol yihiin. La soon Khamiista ama Sabtida.
reason.pilgrimArafah: Looma jecla xujaayga jooga Carafo: Nabiga ﷺ ma uu soomin maalintaas xilligii Xajkiisa.
reason.afterMidShabanShafii: Madhabka Shaafici: soonka bartamaha Shacbaan kadib lama oggola (aragtida la isku halleeyo), haddii aanu ahayn caadadaada, lagu xiray maalmo ka horreeya 15-ka, soon qado ah ama nidar.
reason.afterMidShabanNote: Madhabka Shaafici ma oggola soonka bartamaha Shacbaan kadib sabab la'aan; madhabyada kale xukun gaar ah kama laha.
reason.hayd: Lama soomo xilliga caadada (xayd); maalmaha Ramadaanka ee kaa dhaafay waa la qadeeyaa mar dambe.

quranNotes.title: Qoraalladayda Qur'aanka
quranNotes.subtitle: Fikradahaaga, iftiiminta iyo summadahaaga
quranNotes.notTafsir: Fikirkaaga gaarka ah — ma aha tafsiir.

quranNotes.tvReadOnly: TV-ga qoraallada waa akhris keliya. Ka beddel taleefanka ama shabakadda.

quranNotes.emptyDesc: Fur suurad kasta oo taabo Qoraal ama Iftiimi aayad si aad fikradahaaga halkan ugu kaydiso.
quranNotes.emptyDescTv: Qoraallada aad ku qorto taleefanka ama shabakadda halkan ayay ka muuqdaan kadib isku-dubaridka.

short.body: Caadadaadii ugu dambeysay waxay socotay {{days}} maalmood — ka yar ugu yaraanta madhabkaaga oo ah {{min}} maalmood — sidaa darteed laga yaabo inaan loo tirin xayd. Ka fikir inaad qadaysato salaadahan.
short.bodyAllViews: Caadadaadii ugu dambeysay waxay socotay {{days}} maalmood. Madhabyada qaar waxay dhigaan ugu yaraan 3 maalmood, sidaa darteed halkaas laga yaabo inaan loo tirin xayd; kuwa kalena waxay dhigaan ugu yaraan ka gaaban ama ma dhigaan midna.

purity.body: Kaliya {{days}} maalmood oo daahirnimo ah tan iyo caadadaadii ugu dambeysay — ka yar ugu yaraanta madhabkaaga oo ah {{min}}. Dhiiggan wuxuu noqon karaa istixaado; ka fikir inaad weydiiso caalim.
purity.bodyAllViews: Kaliya {{days}} maalmood oo daahirnimo ah tan iyo caadadaadii ugu dambeysay. Madhabyadu waxay dhigaan ugu yaraan 13–15 maalmood inta u dhaxaysa laba caado, sidaa darteed dhiiggan wuxuu noqon karaa istixaado; ka fikir inaad weydiiso caalim.

dhulHijjah.excusedBanner: Muddadaada cudurdaarka ayaa shidan. Halkan waxba laguma qiimeeyo — samee intaad kartid, dikriga iyo ducaduna mar walba way furan yihiin.
dhulHijjah.disclaimer: Xukunnada madhabyadu ku kala duwan yihiin waa la calaamadeeyay. Xaaladdaada gaarka ah, la tasho caalim aqoon u leh.

spouse.title: Lammaanaha (ninka ama xaaska)
spouse.hint: Lammaane la qabay marxuumka waqtiga geerida.

children.title: Carruurta
children.hint: Wiilasha iyo gabdhaha nool waqtiga geerida.

grandchildren.title: Carruurta wiilka
grandchildren.hint: Carruurta wiil dhintay marxuumka ka hor. Carruurta gabadha kuma jiraan liiskan.

parents.title: Waalidiinta
parents.hint: Aabbaha iyo hooyada nool waqtiga geerida.

grandparents.title: Awoowayaasha iyo ayeeyooyinka
grandparents.hint: Waxaa kaliya la muujiyaa qaraabada aanay waalidiintu horey u xijbin.
grandparents.note: Awoowaha dhinaca aabbe waa aabbaha aabbaha. Awoowaha dhinaca hooyo kuma jiro liiskan.

siblings.title: Walaalaha iyo walaalaha gabdhaha
siblings.hint: Buuxa: aabbe iyo hooyo isku mid ah. Aabbe: aabbe kaliya oo isku mid ah. Hooyo: hooyo kaliya oo isku mid ah.
siblings.withFatherNote: Aabbuhu wuxuu walaalaha iyo walaashaha ka xijaabaa dhaxalka, laakiin laba ama ka badan oo ka mid ah (nooc kasta) weli waxay hooyada saamigeeda ka dhimaan 1/3 ilaa 1/6, sidaa darteed fadlan geli.

extended.title: Wiilasha walaalaha, adeerada iyo ilmo adeerada
extended.hint: Qaraabada ragga ah ee dhinaca aabbaha; waxay dhaxlaan kaliya waxa haray.

confirm.muslim: Dhaxle kasta waa Muslim: dhaxal ma jiro Muslim iyo gaal dhexdooda (Bukhari 6764).
confirm.alive: Dhaxle kasta wuu noolaa xilliga geerida.
confirm.notKiller: Dhaxle midna si xaq darro ah uma dilin marxuumka: dilaagu ma dhaxlo (Tirmidhi 2109).
confirm.noHeirs: Weli dhaxlayaal lama gelin — natiijadu waxay sharxi doontaa waxa markaas dhaca.

estate.title: Hantida (ikhtiyaari)
estate.hint: Kharashka aaska iyo deymaha ayaa marka hore la bixiyaa, kadib wasiyadaha ilaa saddex meelood meel, kadibna dhaxlayaashu waxay qaybsadaan inta hartay.
estate.debtsHint: Wax kasta oo dadku ku lahaayeen marxuumka.
estate.bequestsHint: Kuwa aan dhaxlayaal ahayn. Wixii ka badan saddex meelood meel waa la xaddidaa.
estate.useDebts: Isticmaal deymaha furan ee diiwaanka deymahayga
estate.debtsUnavailable: Lama akhrin karo diiwaanka deymahaaga. Ka fur Deymaha iyo amaanooyinka oo isku day mar kale.
estate.debtsFilled: Waxaa laga buuxiyey haraagaaga furan ee "Waa lagay leeyahay" ee lacagtan.
estate.debtsNone: Ma jiraan deymo furan oo lacagtan ah.
estate.bequestCapped: Wasiyadaha waxaa lagu xaddiday saddex meelood meel: {{amount}}.

compare.allViewsIntro: Waxaad dooratay inaad aragto dhammaan aragtiyada, sidaa darteed afarta madhab ayaa la isbarbardhigay. Dooro madhab si aad u aragto saamiyadeeda oo la sharxay.
compare.title: Afarta madhab oo dhinac dhinac ah
compare.differ: Safafka la iftiimiyey waa ku kala duwan yihiin madhabaha.
compare.same: Afarta madhab oo dhan waa ku heshiiyeen kiiskan.

result.title: Saamiyada — {{school}}
result.dhawuAlArham: Midna dhaxlayaasha liiska ku jira ma joogo. Hantidu waxay u tagtaa qaraabada fog (dhawu al-arham) — Xanafi iyo Xanbali; sidoo kale culimada dambe ee Shaafici iyo Maaliki — qaybinteeda dhexdoodana waxay u baahan tahay caalim.
result.tashih: Asalka la saxay {{base}} si dhaxle kasta u helo saamiyo dhan
result.radd: Waxa dheeraadka ahaa waxaa loo celiyey dhaxlayaasha (radd).

unallocated.spouse_only: {{fraction}} ayaa haray saamiga lammaanaha {{amount}} kadib. Waxay u tagtaa qaraabada fog (dhawu al-arham) haddii ay jiraan; haddii aysan jirin, culimadu way ku kala duwan yihiin in loo celiyo lammaanaha ama khasnadda dadweynaha. La tasho caalim.
unallocated.treasury: {{fraction}} {{amount}} waxay u tagtaa khasnadda dadweynaha (bayt al-mal) xaaladdan.

result.amountEachRange: {{amount}} ({{low}}–{{high}} midkiiba, si sentiyadu si sax ah isugu daraan)
result.debtsExceedEstate: Kharashka aaska iyo deymaha ({{owed}}) ayaa ka badan hantida ({{gross}}), sidaa darteed waxba uma hadhin dardaaranka ama dhaxlayaasha, lacagnana lama muujinayo. Jajabyadu weli waxay muujinayaan sida wax kasta oo hadha deymaha la bixiyo kadib loo qaybin lahaa.

special.umariyyatayn: Kiiska 'Umariyyah: marka uu jiro lammaane iyo labada waalid, hooyadu waxay qaadataa saddex meelood meel inta hartay saamiga lammaanaha kadib — isku mid afarta madhab oo dhan.
special.mushtarakah: Kiiska Mushtarakah: madhabaha way ku kala duwan yihiin in walaalaha buuxa ay la wadaagaan saddex meelood meelka walaalaha hooyada.
special.akdariyyah: Kiiska Akdariyyah: saamiyada awoowaha iyo walaasha waa la isku daraa oo waxaa loo qaybiyaa 2:1.
special.malikiyyah: al-Malikiyyah: madhabka Maaliki awoowuhu wuxuu halkan ku qaataa dhammaan saddex meelood meelka hartay.
special.shibhMalikiyyah: Shibh al-Malikiyyah: culimada Maaliki way ku kala duwan yihiin kiiskan. Natiijada la muujiyey waxay raacaysaa habka guud ee Zayd — la tasho caalim.
special.grandfatherSiblings: Awoowe iyo walaalo ama walaalo gabdho ah: awoowuhu wuxuu qaataa midka ugu wanaagsan: inuu la qaybsado sida walaal, saddex meelood meel inta hartay, ama lix meelood meel (habka Zayd ibn Thabit).

why.nothing_left: Waxba kuma harin iyaga saamiyada go'an kadib.
why.husband_half: Ninku wuxuu qaataa {{fraction}} maxaa yeelay ma jiro ilmo ama ilmo wiil (Qur'aanka 4:12).
why.husband_quarter: Ninku wuxuu qaataa {{fraction}} maxaa yeelay waxaa jira ilmo ama ilmo wiil (Qur'aanka 4:12).
why.wife_quarter: Xaasku waxay qaadataa {{fraction}} — xaasasku way wadaagaan — maxaa yeelay ma jiro ilmo ama ilmo wiil (Qur'aanka 4:12).
why.wife_eighth: Xaasku waxay qaadataa {{fraction}} — xaasasku way wadaagaan — maxaa yeelay waxaa jira ilmo ama ilmo wiil (Qur'aanka 4:12).
why.mother_third: Hooyadu waxay qaadataa {{fraction}}: ilmo ma jiro, walaalahuna waa ka yar yihiin laba (Qur'aanka 4:11).
why.mother_sixth_descendant: Hooyadu waxay qaadataa {{fraction}} maxaa yeelay waxaa jira ilmo ama ilmo wiil (Qur'aanka 4:11).
why.mother_sixth_siblings: Hooyadu waxay qaadataa {{fraction}} maxaa yeelay waxaa jira laba walaalo ah ama ka badan, xitaa kuwa aan dhaxlin (Qur'aanka 4:11).
why.mother_third_of_remainder: Hooyadu waxay qaadataa saddex meelood meel inta hartay saamiga lammaanaha kadib: {{fraction}} hantida.
why.father_sixth: Aabbuhu wuxuu qaataa {{fraction}} maxaa yeelay waxaa jira wiil ama wiil wiil (Qur'aanka 4:11).
why.father_sixth_and_residue: Aabbuhu wuxuu qaataa {{fraction}} iyo wixii haray, maxaa yeelay farcanku waa dumar kaliya.
why.father_residue: Aabbuhu wuxuu qaataa inta hartay isagoo ah qaraabada ragga ugu dhow (Bukhari 6732).
why.grandfather_sixth: Awoowuhu wuxuu galaa booska aabbaha wuxuuna qaataa {{fraction}} marka uu jiro wiil ama wiil wiil.
why.grandfather_sixth_and_residue: Awoowuhu wuxuu galaa booska aabbaha: {{fraction}} iyo wixii haray.
why.grandfather_residue: Awoowuhu wuxuu galaa booska aabbaha wuxuuna qaataa inta hartay.
why.grandmother_sixth: Ayeeyo waxay qaadataa {{fraction}}; laba ayeeyo way wadaagaan (Abu Daawuud 2894).
why.daughter_half: Gabar keli ah oo aan wiil la jirin waxay qaadataa {{fraction}} (Qur'aanka 4:11).
why.daughters_two_thirds: Laba gabdhood ama ka badan oo aan wiil la jirin waxay wadaagaan {{fraction}} (Qur'aanka 4:11).
why.sons_daughter_half: Marka aan wiil iyo gabar midna jirin, gabadha wiilka keli ah waxay qaadataa {{fraction}}.
why.sons_daughters_two_thirds: Marka aan wiil iyo gabar midna jirin, gabdhaha wiilka waxay wadaagaan {{fraction}}.
why.sons_daughter_sixth: Marka ay jirto hal gabar, gabdhaha wiilka waxay qaataan {{fraction}} si loo dhammaystiro saddex meelood labo (Bukhari 6736).
why.sister_half: Walaal gabar keli ah oo aan walaal wiil la jirin waxay qaadataa {{fraction}} (Qur'aanka 4:176).
why.sisters_two_thirds: Laba walaalo gabdho ah ama ka badan waxay wadaagaan {{fraction}} (Qur'aanka 4:176).
why.paternal_sister_sixth: Marka ay jirto hal walaal gabar oo buuxda, walaalaha gabdhaha ee aabbe waxay qaataan {{fraction}} si loo dhammaystiro saddex meelood labo.
why.maternal_sixth: Hal walaal oo hooyo ah wuxuu qaataa {{fraction}} (Qur'aanka 4:12).
why.maternal_third: Walaalaha hooyada waxay si siman u wadaagaan {{fraction}}, lab iyo dhaddig isku mid (Qur'aanka 4:12).
why.residuary_self: Casabo: wuxuu qaataa waxa haray saamiyada go'an kadib (Bukhari 6732).
why.residuary_with_male: Wuxuu inta hartay la wadaagaa {{by}}, labku wuxuu qaataa laba jibbaarka saamiga dhaddigga (Qur'aanka 4:11, 4:176).
why.residuary_with_daughters: Marka ay jiraan {{by}}, walaashu waxay qaadataa waxa haray (Bukhari 6736).
why.awl: Saamiyada go'an waxay ka badan yihiin hantida, sidaa darteed saami kasta waa la dhimay si saami ah ('awl).
why.radd: Waxa dheeraadka ahaa waxaa si saami ah loogu celiyey dhaxlayaasha saamiyada go'an (radd); lammaanayaasha kuma jiraan.
why.umariyyatayn: Tani waa mid ka mid ah labada kiis ee 'Umariyyah oo uu go'aamiyey 'Umar ibn al-Khattab.
why.mushtarakah_share: Mushtarakah: wuxuu si siman ula wadaagaa saddex meelood meelka walaalaha hooyada {{by}} (Shaafici, Maaliki).
why.mushtarakah_excluded: Mushtarakah: saamiyada go'an waxay qaataan hantida oo dhan, sidaa darteed walaalaha buuxa waxba ma helaan (Xanafi, Xanbali).
why.akdariyyah: Akdariyyah: saamiga go'an ({{fraction}}) waxaa lagu daraa {{by}} waxaana loo qaybiyaa 2:1.
why.malikiyyah: al-Malikiyyah (Maaliki): awoowuhu wuxuu qaataa dhammaan saddex meelood meelka hartay.
why.muqasamah_share: Awoowuhu wuxuu walaalaha ula qaybsadaa sida walaal — kan ugu wanaagsan doorashooyinkiisa ({{fraction}}).
why.muqasamah_third: Awoowuhu wuxuu qaataa saddex meelood meel (inta hartay saamiyada go'an kadib) — kana fiican isaga qaybsashada ({{fraction}}).
why.muqasamah_sixth: Awoowuhu wuxuu qaataa lix meelood meel hantida, ugu yaraantiisa ({{fraction}}).
why.muqasamah_siblings: Wuxuu awoowaha ula qaybsadaa habka Zayd ibn Thabit (muqasamah).
why.muaddah_counted: Waxaa lagu tiriyaa awoowaha, kadibna {{by}} ayaa qaata qaybta (mu'addah).
why.muaddah_reclaim: Walaalaha gabdhaha buuxa waxay dib uga qaataan qaybta walaalaha ilaa saamigooda go'an ({{fraction}}) (mu'addah).

umrahMode.title: Habka Cumrada
umrahMode.subtitle: Wehel toos ah oo tallaabo tallaabo kuu raacaya Cumradaada
umrahMode.searchKeywords: cumra umrah hab hage toos ah dawaaf tawaf tiriye saci sai miiqaat miqat digniin ihraam ihram talbiyad xiirasho halq gaabin taqsir zamzam
umrahMode.tvNote: Habka Cumradu wuxuu tiriyaa dawaafka iyo sacyiga, wuxuuna ku hubiyaa miiqaatka taleefankaaga. Halkan waa habka tallaabooyinka.

intro.title: Cumradaada, tallaabo tallaabo
intro.body: Raac cibaado kasta si habaysan: miiqaatka, ihraamka iyo talbiyadda, dawaaf leh tiriye 7 wareeg ah, laba rakcadood, Zamzam, saci leh tiriye 7 socod ah, kadibna xiirasho ama gaabin. Meesha aad marayso waa la kaydiyaa, markaa waad xiri kartaa barnaamijka oo waxaad ka sii wadi kartaa meeshii aad ka joogsatay.
intro.offline: Wuxuu shaqeeyaa internet la'aan. Ducooyinku waxay ka yimaadeen Xisnul Muslim, xukunnada ay madaahibtu ku kala duwan yihiinna waa la calaamadeeyay.

umrahMode.endMessage: Tallaabadaada hadda iyo tirintaadu waa la tirtiri doonaa. Liiska Cumradaada wax saameyn ah kuma yeelanayo.

nextBlocked.tawaf: Tiri dhammaan toddobada wareeg si aad u sii wadato.
nextBlocked.sai: Tiri dhammaan toddobada socod si aad u sii wadato.
nextBlocked.locked: Tallaabadani waxay sugaysaa ilaa aad daahir noqoto.

prepare.title: Diyaargarow
prepare.body: Diyaarso ihraamkaaga iyo waxyaabaha muhiimka ah, baro waxyaabaha ihraamka laga reebay, oo qorshee meesha aad miiqaatka ka dhaafi doonto.

miqat.title: Miiqaat
miqat.body: Ha dhaafin miiqaatka adigoo u socda Makka adigoon ihraamka Cumrada ku jirin. Dhulka, hubi masaafadaada; cirka, deji waqtiga duulimaadkaagu ka gudbayo.

ihram.title: Gal ihraamka
ihram.body: Miiqaatka ama ka hor: qabeyso haddii aad awoodo, xiro dharka ihraamka, kadibna niyeyso Cumrada. Waxyaabaha ihraamka laga reebay hadda ayay bilaabanayaan.

talbiyah.title: Talbiyad
talbiyah.body: Bilow talbiyadda marka aad ihraamka gasho oo badi ku celcelinteeda ilaa aad dawaafka bilowdo.

arrive_haram.title: Gaarista Xaramka
arrive_haram.body: Masjidka Xaramka ku gal ducada masjid galista, kadibna u gudub geesta Dhagaxa Madow si aad dawaafka u bilowdo.

tawaf.title: Dawaaf
tawaf.body: Toddoba wareeg oo Kacbada ah, adigoo bidixdaada ka dhigaya, kana bilaabaya kuna dhammaynaya xariiqda Dhagaxa Madow.

two_rakah_behind_maqam.title: Laba rakcadood oo Maqaamu Ibraahiim ah
two_rakah_behind_maqam.body: Dawaafka kadib, tuko laba rakcadood gadaasha Maqaamu Ibraahiim haddii meel jirto, ama meel kasta oo masjidka ah marka ay buuq tahay.

zamzam.title: Zamzam
zamzam.body: Cab biyaha Zamzam haddii aad awoodo oo ducee. Waa camal la jecel yahay, kamana mid aha cibaadooyinka Cumrada.

sai.title: Saci
sai.body: Toddoba socod oo u dhexeeya Safa iyo Marwa, laga bilaabayo Safa. Safa ilaa Marwa waa hal socod, waxaadna ku dhammaynaysaa Marwa. Raggu waxay ku orodsadaan inta u dhexeysa calaamadaha cagaaran.

halq_taqsir.title: Xiirasho ama gaabin
halq_taqsir.body: Ka bax ihraamka adigoo timaha xiiranaya ama gaabinaya. Sidaas ayay Cumradaadu ku dhammaatay.

complete.title: Cumradii waa dhammaatay
complete.body: Cumradaadu waa dhammaatay. Alle ha kaa aqbalo.

prepare.intention: Niyadda Cumrada waxaa lagu sameeyaa qalbiga marka aad ihraamka gasho, talbiyadduna way ka daba timaadaa.

miqat.approaching: Waxaad ku dhow dahay miiqaatka: {{name}}, qiyaastii {{distance}} km. Ku jir ihraamka ka hor intaadan dhaafin.
miqat.denied: Ogolaanshaha goobta waa dansan yahay. Shid si aad u hubiso masaafadaada, ama raac hagaha kooxdaada.
miqat.unavailable: Goobtaada hadda lama heli karo. Isku day mar kale meel bannaan, ama raac hagaha kooxdaada.
miqat.landHint: Goobtaada waxaa lagu hubiyaa qalabkan oo keliya, inta shaashaddani furan tahay. Lama kaydiyo lamana diro.
miqat.flightCountdown: Qiyaastii {{minutes}} daqiiqo ayaa ka harsan inta duulimaadkaagu ka gudbayo miiqaatka ({{time}}).
miqat.flightNow: Duulimaadkaagu wuxuu ku dhow yahay miiqaatka hadda. Ku jir ihraamka ka hor intaadan dhaafin.
miqat.flightLabel: Goorma ayuu duulimaadkaagu ka gudbayaa miiqaatka?
miqat.flightHint: GPS-ku laguma kalsoonaan karo inta la duulayo. Shirkado badan oo diyaaradeed ayaa ku dhawaaqa miiqaatka, xujey badanna waxay ihraamka galaan ka hor intaysan diyaaradda fuulin.

counter.timerHint: Ikhtiyaari: wuxuu muujiyaa inta uu wareeg kastaa qaatay.

sai.startHint: Ka bilow Safa. Mar kasta oo aad gaarto Marwa ama Safa, taabo si aad u tiriso socodka aad hadda dhammaysay.
sai.purityNote: Weyso waa la jecel yahay sacyiga, laakiin shardi uma aha sacyiga sida ay qabaan aragtiyaha la isku halleeyo ee afarta madhab.

tawaf.startHint: Ka bilow xariiqda Dhagaxa Madow: u jeeso Dhagaxa Madow adigoo tusaya takbiirta hoose, Kacbada bidixdaada ka dhig, oo taabo dhammaadka wareeg kasta.
tawaf.noFixedDua: Ma jirto duco go'an oo wareeg kasta loo leeyahay. Ku ducee ereyadaada iyo luqaddaada, akhri Qur'aanka oo xusuuso Alle. Laba dikri ayaa Sunnada laga soo weriyay: takbiirta Dhagaxa Madow, iyo ducada u dhexeysa Geesta Yamaaniga iyo Dhagaxa Madow ee hoose.
tawaf.doubtBody: Haddii aad shaki qabto, ku dhis tirada yar, tan aad hubto, oo dhammee inta hartay. Shakiga yimaada kadib markaad dhammaysay laguma dhaqmo.

lock.tawaf_purity: Dawaafku wuxuu sugayaa ilaa caadadaada (xayd) ama nifaaskaagu dhammaadaan oo aad qabeysato. Ihraamkaagu sidiisa ayuu ahaanayaa.
lock.salah_purity: Labada rakcadood waxay yimaadaan dawaafka kadib, waxayna sugayaan ilaa aad daahir noqoto.
lock.sai_after_tawaf: Cumrada, sacyigu wuxuu yimaadaa dawaafka kadib, markaa wuxuu sugayaa ilaa aad dawaafka samayso.
lock.wait: Ku sii jir ihraamka oo sii wad ducada iyo dikriga. Markaad daahir noqoto, qabeyso oo dawaafka sii wad. Haddii kooxdaadu ay ka hor tagayso, weydii caalim xaaladdaada.

halq.menBody: Xiirashadu waa ka fadli badan tahay: Nabiga ﷺ wuxuu saddex jeer u duceeyay kuwa xiirta, kadibna kuwa gaabiya.
halq.womenBody: Haweenku ma xiirtaan. Isku soo ururi timaha oo ka gaabi qiyaastii dhererka caarada farta.

complete.duaBody: Ma jirto duco go'an oo waqtigan loo leeyahay. Alle mahadi oo weydii wax kasta oo aad rabto, luqad kasta, naftaada, qoyskaaga iyo Ummadda.

sheet.title: Tirinta gacan la'aanta
sheet.howItWorks: Dheh dhikriga, tiriyuhuna wuu tirin doonaa. Dhegeysigu wuxuu ka dhacaa qalabkan oo keliya: cod lama duubo, lama kaydiyo, lamana diro.
sheet.lowVoice: Cod hoose ayaa ku filan. Dhikriga aamusan iyo taabashaduba isku si ayay u fiican yihiin.
sheet.accuracy: Marka uusan hubin, ma tiriyo. Taabo si aad ugu darto kuwa ka dhaafay.
sheet.unsupported: Tirinta gacan la'aanta laguma heli karo qalabkan.
sheet.model: Wuxuu u baahan yahay dhegeystaha qalabka (qiyaastii {{size}} MB), oo lala wadaago tababarka Qur'aanka. Wi-Fi ayaa lagu talinayaa.
sheet.modelOther: Tababarka Qur'aanku wuxuu qalabkan ku isticmaalaa dhegeyste kale. Kani wuu beddeli doonaa, tababarkuna labadaba wuu la shaqeeyaa.
sheet.downloadFailed: Soo dejintu ma dhammaan. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
sheet.cellular: Kuma xidhnid Wi-Fi. Ma ku soo dejinaysaa xogta mobilka?
sheet.micExplain: Waxaa la isticmaalaa oo keliya inta tiriyuhu dhegeysanayo, qalabkan oo keliya.
sheet.micDenied: Ogolaanshaha makarafoonka waa u dansan yahay app-kan.
sheet.pauseMode: Wuxuu tiriyaa hakad kasta — saxnaan yar. Wuxuu tiriyaa weedh kasta oo aad si gooni ah u tiraahdo isagoon hubin erayada, sidaa darteed taabo si aad u saxdo tiro kasta oo khaldan.

privacy.body: Dhibicda "la dhammeeyay" oo kaliya maalmaha aad doorato inaad wadaagto, iyo magaca aad u doorato goobaabintan. Hadafkaaga, diiwaanka Salaaddaada, qoraallada iyo qazada waligood lama diro. Ducooyinka iyo xusuusinnaduba magac ma leh, mana jiraan dhibcooyin, boqolley ama liisas tartan.

rawatib_start.title: Tallaabada xigta: sunnada
rawatib_start.body: Salaadahaaga fardka ahi way joogto ahaayeen toddobaadkan — Alxamdulillaah. Tallaabo xigta oo qurux badan waa labada rakcadood ee Subaxa ka horreeya.

link.rateLimited: Isku day badan. Fadlan dhowr daqiiqo sug.
link.already: Qalabkan horay ayaa loogu xiray astaan ilmo.
link.privacy: Iimayl ama furaha sirta lama isticmaalo. Waalid ayaa waqti kasta ka goyn kara qalabkan.

salahPath.title: Jidka salaadda
salahPath.intro: Tallaabo tallaabo u baro: marka hore weysada, kadib shanta Salaadood ee maalinlaha ah, kadib sida loo tukado.

prophets.title: Sheekooyinka nebiyada
prophets.intro: Wax ka akhri nebiyadii Alle u soo diray inay dadka hanuuniyaan.

consentPending.title: Waxaa la sugayaa waalidkaa
consentPending.body: Sii wad taabashada Salaaddaada sidii caadiga ahayd. Taabashooyinkaaga waxaa lagu hayaa qalabkan waxaana la wadaagi doonaa marka waalidkaa yiraahdo waa hagaag.

preferredTimeReminder.title: Waqtiga la door bido ee {{prayer}}
preferredTimeReminder.body: Waqtiga la door bido ee {{prayer}} wuu bilaabmay. Waqtiga oo dhammi wuu ansax yahay.
preferredTimeReminder.settingTitle: I xusuusi waqtiga la door bido
preferredTimeReminder.settingSub: Hal xusuusin dheeraad ah marka waqtiga madhabkaagu door bido ee Subax, Casar ama Cishe bilaabmo (meesha uu kaga duwan yahay bilowga). Waqtiyadu waa qiyaas.
preferredTimeReminder.keywords: waqtiga la door bido, mustaxab, isfaar, waqtiga ugu fiican, dib u dhigid, saddex-meelood-meel habeenka, madhab, madhhab

timetableImport.title: Soo geli jadwal
timetableImport.subtitle: Sawir jadwalka daabacan ee masjidkaaga oo hubi waqtiyada ka hor intaadan kaydin.
timetableImport.tvNote: Jadwal ka soo geli app-ka taleefankaaga. Waqtiyadaadu halkan ayay sidoo kale ka muuqan doonaan.
timetableImport.unavailableTitle: Akhrinta qoraalka halkan lama heli karo
timetableImport.unavailableBody: Noocan app-ku ma akhrin karo sawirrada qalabkan. Weli waad qori kartaa waqtiyada masjidkaaga.
timetableImport.onDevice: Waxaa lagu habeeyaa taleefankaaga — sawirka waligiis lama soo geliyo
timetableImport.inBrowser: Waxaa lagu habeeyaa browser-kan — sawirka waligiis lama soo geliyo
timetableImport.reviewSummary: {{filled}} waqti iqaamo ayaa la helay · {{check}} in la hubiyo
timetableImport.reviewHint: Unugyada la iftiimiyay way adkaayeen in la akhriyo ama waxay u muuqdaan kuwo aan caadi ahayn goobtaada. Sax wax kasta oo khaldan, ama tirtir unug si aad uga tagto.
timetableImport.outOfMonth: Saf qaar ayaa dhaafay dhammaadka bishan lamana kaydin doono. Hubi bisha.
timetableImport.fixInvalid_one: {{count}} waqti weli kuma jiro qaabka HH:MM.
timetableImport.fixInvalid_other: {{count}} waqti weli kuma jiraan qaabka HH:MM.
timetableImport.emptyBody: Sawirkaas kama heli karin magacyada Salaadda iyo waqtiyada. Isku day sawir ka cad, toos ah oo shaxda oo kaliya ah, ama qor waqtiyada.
timetableImport.errorBody: Wax ayaa khaldamay inta sawirka la akhrinayay. Isku day mar kale, ama qor waqtiyada.
timetableImport.intro: Soo geli waqtiyada iqaamada ee {{name}} sabuurad maalinle ah oo daabacan ama waraaq bille ah.
timetableImport.tips: Waraaqda si siman u dhig, shaxda ku buuxi qaabka, kana fogow iftiinka dhalaalaya. Haddii aad awooddo u jar shaxda.
timetableImport.webDownload: Markii ugu horreysay, browser-kaagu wuxuu ka soo dejiyaa qiyaastii {{size}} MB oo xog akhrinta qoraalka ah jsDelivr (CDN dadweyne). Xogta oo kaliya ayaa la soo dejiyaa — sawirkaagu wuxuu ku jiraa browser-kan.
timetableImport.webCached: Xogta akhrinta qoraalka horay ayaa loogu kaydiyay browser-kan.
timetableImport.arabicToggle: Sidoo kale akhri qoraalka Carabiga (+{{size}} MB)
timetableImport.keepPhotoHint: Wuxuu muujiyaa sawirka agtiisa waqtiyada. Waa la tirtiraa markaad kaydiso ama baxdo.
timetableImport.cameraDenied: Gelitaanka kamaradu waa dansan yahay. Ka shid Dejinta, ama beddelkeeda dooro sawir.
timetableImport.privacy: Waqtiyada aad soo geliso waxaa loo kaydiyaa sida Waqtiyadaada masjidkaaga: gaar u ah qalabkaaga, waligoodna lala wadaagin isticmaalayaasha kale.
timetableImport.nothingToSave: Weli ma jiraan waqtiyo iqaamo oo la kaydiyo.
timetableImport.invalidHint: U qor waqtiga sida HH:MM, tusaale 13:30.

flag.lowConfidence: Way adag tahay in la akhriyo
flag.iqamahWindow: Farqi aan caadi ahayn Aadaanka kadib
flag.columnUnclear: Cinwaanka tiirka ma cada — hubi Salaaddan midda ay tahay

timetableImport.beginsOnly: Waraaqdani waxay taxdaa oo kaliya waqtiyada bilowga (Aadaanka), sidaa darteed waqtiyo iqaamo lagama qaadan. Hoos ku qor waqtiyada iqaamada ee masjidkaaga.
timetableImport.monthWrap: Waraaqdani waxay gashaa bisha xigta. Hubi in bisha kor ku qoran ay tahay bisha waraaqdu ka bilaabato.
timetableImport.dateColumnBody: Waraaqdani waxay leedahay in ka badan hal tiir oo tirooyinka maalmaha ah. Dooro midka leh maalinta bisha — ma aha maalinta Ramadaanka ama Hijriga.

masjidLog.tahiyyatNextIqamah: Iqaamada xigta ee masjidkaaga: {{prayer}} saacadda {{time}}. In dhowr daqiiqo hore la yimaado waxay waqti u reebtaa labadan rakcadood.

quranPronunciation.title: Hubi dhawaaqa
quranPronunciation.intro: Aayadda shaashadda ku jirta kor u akhri, kadib taabo Dhammee. Eray kastaa wuxuu ku soo noqdaa Cad, Mar kale dhageyso ama Ma hubo. Wax walba waxay ku jiraan qalabkaaga.
quranPronunciation.listening: Waa la dhageysanayaa… xawaarahaaga ku akhri, kadib taabo Dhammee.
quranPronunciation.assessing: Waa la dib u eegayaa akhriskaaga…
quranPronunciation.unavailable: Hubinta dhawaaqa lama heli karo qalabkan.
quranPronunciation.micDenied: Makarafoonku waa u dansan yahay app-kan. Ka shid Dejinta si aad u hubiso akhriskaaga.

noFit.too-many-flags: Aayaddan si cad looma raaci karin. Isku day mar kale meel ka aamusan, adigoo taleefanka wax yar u dhow.

calibrate.cta: Akhri hal aayad si loogu habeeyo codkaaga
calibrate.intro: Habeyn: aayaddan u akhri sidaad caadi ahaan u akhrido, kadib taabo Dhammee. Tani waxay hagaajinaysaa oo kaliya inta hubintu taxaddar leedahay qalabkan.
calibrate.saved: Waa loo habeeyay qalabkan. Hubintaada xigta ayaa isticmaali doonta.
calibrate.not-enough: Taasi kuma filnayn habeynta. Isku day aayad wax yar ka dheer.
calibrate.no-fit: Akhriskaas lama raaci karin, sidaa darteed waxba lama kaydin. Isku day mar kale.
calibrate.error: Habeyntu ma dhammaan. Waxba lama kaydin.

model.title: Soo deji dhageystaha
model.body: Hubinta dhawaaqu waxay isticmaashaa dhageyste qalabka ku jira (qiyaastii {{size}} MB, waxaa la wadaagaa tababarka Qur'aanka iyo tasbeeh gacan-la'aan). Wi-Fi ayaa lagu talinayaa.
model.otherEngine: Hubinta dhawaaqu waxay u baahan tahay dhageystaha FastConformer. Soo dejintiisu waxay beddeshaa dhageystahaaga tababarka ee hadda; tababarku wuu ku sii shaqeynayaa.

copy.tartil: Waqti qaado — ku akhri tartiil degan.
copy.effort: Akhriska dadaalka lehna ajar buu leeyahay: qofka Qur'aanku ku adag yahay oo sii wada wuxuu leeyahay laba ajar.
copy.teacher: Tani waa caawimaad tababar, ma aha xukun akhriskaaga. Akhriskaaga ku hubi macallin aqoon leh.

summary.title: Akhriskaaga
summary.nothingFlagged: Markan ma jiraan erayo mar kale la dhageysto.
summary.feedsCoaching: Erayadan waxaa loo isticmaali doonaa tusaalooyin tababarkaaga tajwiidka. Waxaad tan ka demin kartaa Dejinta › Qur'aan › Tababar.
summary.feedOff: Ku darista erayadan tababarka tajwiidka waa dansan tahay Dejinta › Qur'aan › Tababar.

tajweedCoaching.title: Ku tababar dhawaaqyadan
tajweedCoaching.intro: Qorshe gaaban oo laga dhisay tababarkaaga Qur'aanka. Wuxuu doortaa dhawaaqyada tajwiidka ee ka muuqda aayadaha aad ka shaqeyneyso wuxuuna isticmaalaa erayo akhriskaaga ka yimid tusaale ahaan.
tajweedCoaching.honesty: Qorshahani ma aha xukun tajwiidkaaga: wuxuu ka yimid erayo dhageystuhu kaa codsaday inaad mar kale isku daydo, app-kuna ma hubin karo tajwiidka gudaha aayadda. Tababarrada dhawaaqu waxay dhageystaan hal dhawaaq hal eray, oo kaliya meesha hubintaas la cabbiray inay shaqeyso. Macallin aqoon leh ayaa ah hagaha ugu fiican.
tajweedCoaching.tvReadOnly: Tababarku wuxuu u baahan yahay makarafoon, sidaa darteed wuxuu ku jiraa taleefankaaga, tablet-kaaga ama kombiyuutarkaaga. Weli halkan waad ku akhrin kartaa xeerarka oo dhageysan kartaa erayada.
tajweedCoaching.summaryIntro: Laga soo qaaday aayadaha aad hadda ku tababartay.
tajweedCoaching.privacy: Qorshahaaga waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa qalabkan. Codka akhriskaagu waligiis kama baxo.

empty.offline: Hal mar ku xiro internetka si app-ku u soo qaato calaamadaha tajwiidka aayadahaaga. Kadib, wuxuu shaqeeyaa internet la'aan.
empty.nothing: Aayadaha aad dhowaan ku tababartay weli kuma jiro dhawaaq la tababaro. Sii wad tababarka qorshuhuna wuu kori doonaa.
empty.noPractice: Ku tababar dhowr aayadood tababarka Qur'aanka, qorshahaaga tababarkuna halkan ayuu ka soo muuqan doonaa.

evidence.intro: Ka fur ilaha akhriyayaasha Qur'aanka iyo xadiiska.

evidence.twoRewards: Laba ajar qofka ku akhriya dhib — Riyad as-Salihin 315 (Bukhari iyo Muslim)

coach.wordsIntro: Mid kasta oo ka mid ah erayadan waxaa ku jira {{rule}}. Taabo eray si aad u maqasho akhriyaha.

coach.listenIntro: Taabo eray kasta si aad u maqasho akhriyaha, kadib dhowr jeer ku celi xawaarahaaga. App-ku halkan ma dhageysto mana xukumo.
coach.listenedToast: Waa la xusay — dhawaaqani wuxuu dib ugu soo laaban doonaa qorshahaaga goor dambe.
